company.name: Healine
company.shortDescription: Healine is a platform that connects people with healthcare services.
company.description: Healine is a platform that connects people with healthcare services in the UAE. The service includes finding hospitals across the country. It also helps users locate clinics with detailed information and reviews. The platform allows booking of appointments with doctors in different specialties. It offers medical services such as lab tests, vaccinations, flu shots, and IV therapy. Health insurance plans can be compared and purchased through the platform. Users can also access medical reports and health analytics to follow their health progress.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $130,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,637,946 to $1,637,946, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (+39 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
